components.name: Refresh
components.description: Static web translation of the native refresh button; active and disabled opacity match source. No custom hover/focus treatment is defined.
components.css: .ds-refresh { background:#c42b22; color:#ffffff; min-height:44px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-refresh:active { opacity:.75; } .ds-refresh:disabled { opacity:.6; }

components.name: Retry
components.description: Bordered recovery action. The native retry source defines no authored hover/focus/pressed variant.
components.css: .ds-retry { background:#ffffff; color:#c42b22; min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid #dce2e8; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Club search
components.description: Search field with native browser focus behavior in this static translation.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" aria-label="Поиск по названию клуба" placeholder="Найти клуб" />
components.css: .ds-search { min-height:48px; min-width:160px; max-width:360px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid #dce2e8; border-radius:8px; background:#ffffff; color:#17212b; font-size:14px; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color:#596674; }

components.name: Selected filter
components.description: One selected filter tab; static selected state.
components.css: .ds-tab { min-height:44px; padding:0 13px; border:0; border-radius:7px; background:#17212b; color:#ffffff; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-tab:active { opacity:.75; }

components.name: Live status
components.description: Noninteractive live badge; text accompanies its color and circular indicator.
components.css: .ds-live { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border-radius:6px; padding:5px 9px; background:#eaf6ef; color:#176947; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:3px; background:#176947; }

components.name: Match card surface
components.description: Static surface preview; full native MatchCard contains status, favorite, clubs, score and date.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#ffffff; border:1px solid #dce2e8; border-radius:14px; padding:18px; color:#17212b; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: This records the implemented single-screen Expo / React Native system. It extends the original white surface, dark sans text and red favorite accent. The README calls for a neat, readable test assignment; there is no separately approved brand metaphor or new visual identity.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white cards on a pale neutral page.
Red actions and favorites; green live status.
dos: Do reuse the theme color roles and existing component shapes.
Do preserve wrapping, device-local time labels and accessible control states.
Do keep scores prominent and supporting copy subdued.
donts: Don't encode status or favorite selection through color alone.
Don't document custom fonts, animations, shadows or hover treatments as implemented when they are absent.
